# `bin/lint-brief`

A tool: run it from the root of an instance (or of the kit, for the kit's own tools).
Source: [`bin/lint-brief`](../../../bin/lint-brief)

## What it says about itself

```text
bin/lint-brief RUN        (LESSONS.md "Unknown or misplaced fields are errors", after the source's run 086)

Read-only for the run. The packet scan keeps an index of blocked material at .claude/state/packet-index.json (a
cache, used only when the instance has block rules; the launch path, --packet, rebuilds the index from the files and
never reads the cache).

Lints a run's BRIEF.md against SCHEMAS.md before the user's gate. Run it before bin/manifest.
  ERR   an unfilled ⟨slot⟩ of the bin/new-run skeleton
  ERR   a line that names `deps` without naming `artifact` (outside a ```json block): run 086's brief said
        "lists it in `deps`" and the worker put deps at the claim's top level, where nothing reads it
  ERR   a backticked `artifact.x` that SCHEMAS.md §1 does not have
  WARN  the brief allows more tool calls than bin/run-external's default --max-turns (pass it explicitly)
  WARN  a HARNESS-NOTE.md for a networked route while the brief says "no network"
  ERR   the packet (BRIEF.md, HARNESS-NOTE.md, input/) carries blocked material, by bytes or shared text; WARN if it
        names it (bin/_packet.py; LESSONS.md "No packet carries blocked material")
  ERR   a route-verdict word ("ranking #7", PARK, PURSUE, DEAD, …) on any line of a packet file, where the instance's
        data/packet-rules.json has "verdicts" on (the default for a new instance)
Exit 1 on any ERR.
bin/lint-brief --packet RUN   the packet scan alone (bin/run-external runs it before touching the approval); exit 1 on a
                              finding, 4 if the scan itself failed
```

## Lessons it cites

- → **Unknown or misplaced fields are errors**
- → **No packet carries blocked material**

## Ledger events it writes

None.
